```yaml
name: "Release: Cut"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirm:
        description: "Confirm you want to start a new release cycle"
        required: true
        default: "false"
        type: choice
        options:
          - "false"
          - "true"

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  cut-release-branch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate confirmation
        if: github.event.inputs.confirm != 'true'
        run: |
          echo "::error::Confirmation input must be 'true' to proceed."
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create release/candidate branch
        run: |
          # Check if branch already exists
          if git ls-remote --heads origin release/candidate | grep -q release/candidate; then
            echo "::error::Branch 'release/candidate' already exists. Please delete it or finalize the previous release before cutting a new one."
            exit 1
          fi

          # Create and push the branch from main
          git checkout -b release/candidate
          git push origin release/candidate
          
          echo "Successfully created and pushed 'release/candidate' branch."

      - name: Trigger Release Please
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: "Release: Please"
          inputs: '{"target_branch": "release/candidate"}'
```
